newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London barely changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London barely changed in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were little changed in quiet trade on Thursday but the bias was on the upside as HSBC Holdings was dragged higher in line with London's FTSE 100 index.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 11.85 points at 12,370.55 by 0224 GMT. In Hong Kong the Hang Seng finished 67.98 points or 0.55 percent lower at 12,358.7.
"We have seen a little bit of demand in Hong Kong bank," said one dealer.
"The UK market performed quite well after the sell-off overnight on Wall Street."
HSBC Holdings was trading at HK$182.3 in London after a Hong Kong close of HK$181.0.
"Everything else is trading very much around the (HK) close," the dealer said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
